nodes.title: ⚠️ Tips
widgets_values:
### Load an image and an audio file (either your own or the original audio from the source video), or alternatively use LTX Audio—the audio is used for lip synchronization. Then load the target video to track and transfer its movements.

### The output video length is determined by the number of frames loaded from the input video (frame_load_cap), not by the duration of the loaded audio file. For the "Final Audio", you can choose either the original audio input (your own audio or the original audio from the source video) or the audio used during the video creation process. This is important if you want to prevent lip sync. For this, select "Original Audio Input" and LTX Audio. Of course, you must formulate the prompt in such a way that no speech output occurs.

### If you experience issues with lip sync, try lowering the IC-LoRA Strength and IC-LoRA Guidance Strength values. A value of around 0.7-0.8 is a good starting point.

### If you notice issues with output quality, try lowering the IC-LoRA Strength as well.

## Refine and Upscale (Detailer):

### You can also refine and upscale an existing video by setting ControlNet to "Off", Image Bypass to "True" and loading the IC-LoRA file for the detailer "ltx-2-19b-ic-lora-detailer.safetensors" instead of the ControlNet model "ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors".
